title: Valkyrie of the Ancient Shield
description: A glowing ethereal woman with long flowing white hair floats in the center, holding a dark ornate mirror in one hand and reaching toward a large blue wooden shield with golden pinecones. The shield features a white helmet with a black cross above it. Ruined classical columns and stairs appear in the background under a starry twilight sky, surrounded by black ravens, pink flowers, dripping golden ribbons, and a vertical banner reading 'Forest'.
prompt: An ethereal glowing woman with long flowing white hair and a translucent dress floats in a starry twilight sky, holding an ornate dark mirror. She reaches toward a large blue wooden shield decorated with two golden pinecones. A white helmet with black cross emblem floats above the shield. Behind her are ruined Greek columns and stairs. Black ravens fly around, pink flowers and dripping golden ribbons swirl in the foreground, a vertical golden banner reads 'Forest' on the right side, mystical and symbolic atmosphere.
